'''Compactor droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed by the [[unidentified Iokath species]] to tend to gardens and parks on their artificial world of [[Iokath]]. The species went extinct following the [[Iokath Civil War]] and Compactor droids were repurposed by [[ARIES]] into the combat units, aggressive to any intruders.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Compactor droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as emenies on Iokath.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
